posts.title: My Take on Masterwork Weapons
posts.description: Recently, a player asked if there's a way to "upgrade" their equipment or buy better weapons. My eyes went black. "Upgrade?" I shouted. "Better equipment?" I jumped from my seat and knocked over a bowl of chips. The group went quiet. I pointed my finger in the players face and then slammed it on the table, where a copy of Moldvay Basic happens to be open to page B27. "You see where it says 'sword?
